clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Vagash threatens the breeders’ prized rams from the snowy crags. The Fang of Vagash proves the notorious marauding predator has been slain.

Vagash is a savage beast that stalks downhill from the ridges above Amberstill Ranch, often under cover of darkness, to slaughter prized rams. Dun Morogh’s high crags shelter bitter cold and fierce predators, but none have plagued the local ranches as Vagash has. Ironforge’s troops are stretched thin, leaving herdsmen without the city guard’s protection. A severed fang gives the breeders proof that Vagash is dead and the pasturelands are safe again.
